value.rationale: The object is the simplest closed stochastic metapopulation in which directed intervention is meaningful, and mean regional extinction time is an ecologically interpretable management quantity. The all-rate solution classifies balanced/interior/extreme interventions sharply for every initial occupancy distribution, demonstrating a counterintuitive shift to fully directional rescue under single-patch initial occupancy even when patch extinction rates are identical. The universal negative curvature gives an exact misallocation penalty. This is a natural, motivated, complete classification, not a routine numerical table, with its deliberately minimal ecological scope and estimation limits stated.
